card: Adds a unit test to verify that Knapsack coin selection continues evaluating remaining candidate groups after encountering an overweight group. Existing wallet test suites failed to catch a mutant replacing continue with break, which would cause coin selection to fail when overweight groups appear early in the evaluation order. The author confirmed the mutant survives on master across all five wallet test suites and is caught by this test.
evidence: Author tested mutation testing dashboard results and confirmed the mutant survived across all five wallet test suites on current master (PR description).
Author confirmed the proposed test passes on master and fails when the loop's `continue` is replaced with `break` (PR description).
problem: Existing wallet test suites did not test whether Knapsack continues searching after encountering an overweight group. A bug or mutation substituting `break` for `continue` would silently pass tests while prematurely aborting coin selection when overweight groups are encountered early in the shuffled list.

risk.why: Only adds test coverage to wallet coin selection without changing production code.

scope_notes: Small test addition (+19 lines); the diff was not included in the prompt.
summary: Adds a test to verify that the Knapsack coin selection algorithm skips groups exceeding maximum selection weight and continues evaluating remaining groups. The test constructs several overweight groups and one valid group to ensure selection succeeds despite random shuffling.
